FRNK406.shortDescription: Explore key highlights of the route at an easy pace, with structured sightseeing and relaxed evenings.

days.title: AGRA — Arrival
days.description: Upon your arrival at the Agra railway station, you will be welcomed by the local representative. After a brief moment of repose and a relaxed breakfast, you will begin a journey to the world-renowned Taj Mahal, where the plan includes be enchanted by its timeless beauty and marvel at its splendid architecture (admission ticket only, excluding museum entry). After savoring a satisfying lunch, the day includes explore the striking Agra Fort, a true architectural marvel that houses the breathtaking Pearl Mosque and the resplendent halls that once hosted both public and private audiences. you will gracefully conclude the day with a pleasant dinner and seek an early night's rest. Lunch and dinner are included.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: DELHI — Sightseeing or Industrial visit.
days.description: After a enjoyable breakfast, the drive will lead us to the magnificent Akshardham Temple, where you will be immersed in vibrant devotional traditions and captivated by the awe-inspiring architecture. Later, the plan includes visit the Lotus Temple, a mesmerizing structure crafted in the shape of a delicate lotus flower. After enjoying a delicious lunch, the day includes visit the iconic India Gate, a solemn and grand war memorial erected in honor of the brave Indian soldiers who sacrificed their lives during World War I. By 3 in the afternoon, you will start a engaging journey to Jammu. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included.

days.title: JAMMU — SRINAGAR
days.description: Morning: 7:00 AM - Arrival in Jammu and transfer to Srinagar by road (approximately 8 hours) or by Vande Bharath (approximately 3 hours) Overnight stay in Srinagar. Dinner Included
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: SONAMARGH
days.description: Sonmarg means "Meadow of Gold." With its rolling hills and lush green meadows on either side of the road, this valley is framed by tall, snow-capped mountains, making it incredibly picturesque! Ponies can be hired for the trip to Thajiwas Glacier, a major attraction during the summer months. In the evening, you will return to Srinagar. Overnight stay at a hotel in Srinagar. Breakfast and dinner are included.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: GULMARGH
days.description: 9:00 AM - After breakfast, you will leave for Gulmarg (8,700 ft), the most beautiful summer resort in the valley. Gulmarg is one of the best hill stations in the world and India’s premier ski resort in winter. It also boasts the world’s highest golf course. The Gondola cable car offers rides to the upland meadows of Kongdori and beyond to the top of the Apharwat range, reaching a height of 14,000 ft, providing stunning views of the Himalayan peaks in summer and opportunities for downhill skiing in winter. You can enjoy the Gondola cable car ride at your own expense. Overnight stay at a hotel in Srinagar. Breakfast and dinner are included.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: PAHALGAM
days.description: After breakfast, you will begin a full-day excursion to Pahalgam (6,997 ft), also known as "The Valley of Shepherds" or a trekker’s paradise. En route, the plan includes visit the Pampore saffron fields, one of the most beautiful places on earth. The town of Pahalgam offers breathtaking views, and you can enjoy a pony ride to Baisaran Valley. Additionally, visits to Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari can be arranged by special vehicle at your own cost. In the evening, the day includes return to Srinagar. Overnight stay at a hotel in Srinagar. Breakfast and dinner are included.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: SRINAGAR — DELHI - Departure
days.description: In the morning, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed to Jammu. En route, you will stop at the Patnitop viewpoint. The journey will take approximately 8 hours by road and 3 Hours by Vande Bharath You will be dropped off at Jammu railway station. Breakfast is included.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: DELHI — Departure
days.description: Early morning drop-off at Delhi railway station.

days.title: DELHI AGRA

days.title: KASHMIR
days.description: Transportation and sightseeing by non ac bus 04 night accommodation at deluxe hotel (quadruple sharing) 04 Breakfast 04 dinner Garden entry in Srinagar Shikara ride in Dal lake (01 hr)
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: EXCLUSIONS
days.description: Expenses of a personal nature, such as porterage, tips, laundry, camera fees, mineral water, additional rides, boating, pony rides, gondola rides, and any optional tours. Visits to Zero Point and Tajwas Glacier at Sonamarg, as well as taxi charges to Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, and Chandanwari at Pahalgam, are not included. Any additional nights will be charged on a pro-rata basis. For Gondola tickets, the supplementary cost is Rs. 750 per person for the first phase and Rs. 950 per person for the second phase, totaling Rs. 1,800 per person for both phases. The supplementary cost for visiting Zero Point and Fish Point at Sonamarg is Rs. 4,500-5,000 per vehicle (2-9 passengers per vehicle), provided by local taxi services. The supplementary cost for visiting Thajwas Glacier at Sonamarg is Rs. 1,000 per person, using pony/horse transport.

Next, we venture through the magnificent Atal Tunnel, an engineering marvel that connects Manali to Lahaul-Spiti Valley. For those seeking an extra dose of adventure, we have the option to explore the legendary Rohtang Pass (available at an additional cost during the peak season of May to August). Here, nature reveals its grandeur with snow- capped peaks, pristine glaciers, and breathtaking vistas. As the sun begins its descent, you will start the journey towards Kasol. upon our arrival in Kasol, we gather around a cozy campfire, the dancing flames casting a warm glow upon our faces.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

days.title: KASOL
days.description: After indulging in a hearty breakfast, we set out on a sacred journey to the revered Manikaran Gurudwara, nestled amidst the awe-inspiring beauty of the Himalayas. As we bask in the serenity, we also have the opportunity to experience the therapeutic hot springs that surround the Gurudwara, rejuvenating both body and soul. After this profound experience, we continue our adventure and drop you off at the lively Kasol market, where a tapestry of colors, aromas, and treasures awaits. After immersing ourselves in the lively energy of Kasol market, we venture back to our resort through the scenic Chalal village, traversing scenic trails that unveil the true essence of nature's splendour. After lunch, we take a moment to sit back and relax before the route to Delhi. We allow ourselves some time to relax and recharge, enjoying the calm and tranquility of the surroundings.
days.accommodation: Hotel stay included

FWS252.overview: A thoughtfully planned travel experience. Explore MALWAN (2DAY 3NIGHT).
FWS252.shortDescription: Experience MALWAN with a clear day-by-day plan across this 2day 3night package.

days.title: GOA
days.description:
09:00 — Upon reaching Goa, you will enjoy breakfast as the official check-in time is 12:00 PM. Yet, if the rooms happen to be available beforehand, the schedule includes prioritize freshening up before proceeding.

15:00 — Leaving the breakfast area behind, you will make our way to the Aguada Fort is indeed a historical fort that showcases the rich heritage of the region and provides stunning views of the surrounding coastline.

15:00 — After our lunch break, you will proceed to Anjuna beach before embarking on an exploration of Baga beach and Tittos line, famous for their bustling nightlife.

11:30 — After indulging in the excitement of the night, you will conclude your day by returning to the hotel for a well- deserved rest.
days.accommodation: 11:30 — After indulging in the excitement of the night, you will conclude your day by returning to the hotel for a well- deserved rest.

days.title: MALWAN - WATER SPORTS
days.description:
06:00 — 6 a.m. journey to Malwas Island: Begin your adventure to Malwas Island promptly at 6 o'clock in the morning, with an approximate travel time of 2 hours.

09:00 — Enjoy your breakfast upon arrival, and then dive into an exciting array of water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, banana rides, boating, and basic scuba diving.

15:30 — After the completion of water sports, you will be served lunch. Following the meal, you will be dropped off at Calangute Market for further exploration

20:30 — Upon concluding our adventures in the market, you will sit down for a enjoyable dinner before embarking on our return journey to our hometown.

FWS253.shortDescription: A balanced 2day 3night itinerary covering key highlights of the route, with time for landmarks and local experiences.

days.title: HAMPI
days.description:
07:00 — Arrival and rejuvenate

09:00 — Following a scrumptious breakfast, you will venture forth to visit the Elephant Stable, Hawa Mahal, and Hazara Rama Temple. Prepare to be enthralled by the rich history and cultural heritage of these magnificent landmarks. Explore the Elephant Stable, admire the intricate craftsmanship of the Hawa Mahal, and experience the tranquility of the Hazara Rama Temple.

15:00 — Once we've savoured a delicious lunch, the drive takes us to the iconic Vijay Vittala Temple, known for its extraordinary musical pillars. Prepare to be mesmerized by the enchanting sounds they produce. Afterward, you will start a scenic trek to the Mathanga hill, where you can immerse yourself in the vibrant sunset.

18:00 — After a day of exploration, you will enjoy dinner and rest for the night at hotel.
days.accommodation: 18:00 — After a day of exploration, you will enjoy dinner and rest for the night at hotel.

days.title: HAMPI
days.description:
09:00 — After breakfast, you will transport you to the vicinity of Virupaksha Temple and Hampi Market, where you can delve into the rich history and vibrant traditions of the region.

14:00 — Once we have completed our lunch, you will accompany you to Anjunadri Hill, affectionately known as the Monkey Temple, for a mesmerizing sunset view. If you wish to, you can further explore the lively Hippy Street.

19:30 — Upon concluding our adventures in the Hampi, you will sit down for a enjoyable dinner before embarking on our return journey to our hometown.

18:00 — After a day of exploration, you will enjoy dinner and rest for the night at hotel.

days.description:

Spanning over 1,666 acres, it holds the prestigious Guinness World Records title as the largest film studio in the world. Conceived in 1996 by Telugu media mogul Ramoji Rao, this exceptional establishment aims to emulate the grandeur of Hollywood studios, and it's often referred to as a 'city within a city.'

18:00 — Once we've checked out from Ramoji film city, the evening invites us to experience the shopping delights of Hyderabad. Embrace the local flavours, enjoy the lively atmosphere, and shop for unique finds that capture the essence of this remarkable city.

10:30 — After indulging in the excitement of the night, you will conclude your day by returning to the hotel after dinner for a well-deserved rest.

Spanning over 1,666 acres, it holds the prestigious Guinness World Records title as the largest film studio in the world. Conceived in 1996 by Telugu media mogul Ramoji Rao, this exceptional establishment aims to emulate the grandeur of Hollywood studios, and it's often referred to as a 'city within a city.'

09:00 — After enjoying breakfast, you will make our way to Ramoji Film City, a sprawling integrated film studio complex. Spanning over 1,666 acres, it holds the prestigious Guinness World Records title as the largest film studio in the world. Conceived in 1996 by Telugu media mogul Ramoji Rao, this exceptional establishment aims to emulate the grandeur of Hollywood studios, and it's often referred to as a 'city within a city.'

18:00 — Once we've checked out from Ramoji film city, the evening invites us to experience the shopping delights of Hyderabad. Embrace the local flavours, enjoy the lively atmosphere, and shop for unique finds that capture the essence of this remarkable city.

10:30 — After indulging in the excitement of the night, you will conclude your day by returning to the hotel after dinner for a well-deserved rest.
